title: Veteran college athletics administrator Shawn Eichorst appointed University of Wisconsin Director of Athletics
summary_en: A proven and respected college sports executive, attorney and former collegiate athlete, Shawn Eichorst has been appointed as the University of Wisconsin–Madison's Director of Athletics.
